stable.notes: Fenced threads are now visible and releasable from Control. When COS sends a turn to a thread on your Mac and never learns whether it arrived, it stops writing to that thread so the same message cannot land twice. Until now the only thing that cleared it was restarting the server, and there was no way to see that it had happened. A card now lists any fenced threads with when each was fenced, and Release reopens one after a confirmation. The card only appears when there is something to act on. Needs COS Glasses server 6.36.10.
